conbody.p: You can save a diagram at any point while creating it. When you save a diagram, draw.io stores it in the selected location. You can save a diagram using Save or Save As. The option you use depends on whether you want to save changes to an existing diagram or save a diagram as a new file.

li.p: Save:Use this option to save changes to a diagram that has already been saved. For instructions, see .
Save as: Use this option to save a new diagram or save an existing diagram with a different file name or location. For instructions, see .

conbody.p: When saving a diagram, you can select a supported online storage service or your local computer as the storage location, depending on the options available in your draw.io environment. This section covers the process of saving the file in the local system.
The XML (.drawio) format is selected by default when saving a diagram as a draw.io file. If you want to continue making changes to the diagram, save in this format.
